request_payload.title: Converging roles of PSENEN/PEN2 and CLN3 in the autophagy-lysosome system.

mentions.sentence: Following previous studies, we demonstrate that PSENEN is essential for forming a functional γ-secretase complex and is indispensable for γ-secretase activity.
